{Living Adventure Tweak}

Settings of the Living Adventure Map: the wind compass, the sound volumes, the effects and the creature life. The compass icon opens the wind window.

tip.wind: Choose the wind (the wind window has its own OK / Cancel)
tip.windNoGame: Only on the adventure map of a game
tip.hideCompass: Hide the wind compass from the adventure map (the compass ini keys stay as they are)
tip.corner: The corner of the map view where the compass sits
tip.size: How big the compass is on the map
tip.volume: All sounds of this mod (on top of the game's sound effects volume)
tip.windvol: The wind and the leaves, on top of the mod volume
tip.trees: Trees and plants sway in the wind
tip.leaves: The wind takes leaves, needles and snow off the trees
tip.birds: Birds fly over the map and land on roofs, trees and lakes
tip.wildlife: Animals can be seen now and then
tip.smoke: Smoke rising from campfires and chimneys
tip.mills: Windmills turn with the wind and stand still in a calm
tip.millUnder: Windmills underground turn with the wind above ground (no other wind underground)
tip.banks: Bank guards (the Dragon Utopia too) fly, walk or swim around the bank until it is cleared
tip.dwellings: Creatures come out of dwellings that have some to hire (half of them, at most 2 at a time)
tip.objects: Life at adventure objects: swordsmen train in front of Marletto Tower
